operations.name: get_person

operations.name: get_school
operations.description: Cost: 1 credit / successful request. Get structured data of a School Profile.

operations.name: list_employees
operations.description: Cost: 3 credits / employee returned. Get a list of employees of a Company.

operations.name: get_employee_count
operations.description: Cost: 1 credit / successful request. Get the total number of employees of a company.

operations.name: lookup_person
operations.description: Cost: 2 credits / successful request. Look up a person with a name and company information. Credits are charged by default even when no match is found; use `similarity_checks=skip` to avoid charges on null results.

operations.name: lookup_company
operations.description: Cost: 2 credits / successful request. Resolve a Company Profile from company name, domain name, and location. Credits are charged on any 200 response, including when no matching company is found and the result contains a null value.

operations.name: lookup_role
operations.description: Cost: 3 credits / successful request. Returns the profile of a person who most closely matches a specified role in a company. For instance, it can identify the "CTO" of "Apple". The endpoint returns a single result that represents the closest match. Credits are charged on any 200 response, including when no matching profile is found. For a detailed comparison, see the [Employee Search Endpoint](#company-api-employee-search-endpoint) or the [Person Search Endpoint](#search-api-person-search-endpoint).

operations.name: lookup_company_id
operations.description: Cost: 0 credit / successful request. Look up the vanity ID of a company by its numeric ID.

operations.name: search_employees
operations.description: Cost: 10 credits / successful request. Search employees of a target company by their job title. This API endpoint is syntactic sugar for the `role_search` parameter under the [Employee Listing Endpoint](#company-api-employee-listing-endpoint). For a detailed comparison, see the [Role Lookup Endpoint](#people-api-role-lookup-endpoint) or the [Person Search Endpoint](#search-api-person-search-endpoint).

operations.name: lookup_email
operations.description: Cost: 3 credits / successful request. Resolve a person profile from an email address. Works with both personal and work email addresses. Credits are charged by default (`lookup_depth=deep`) even when no match is found; use `lookup_depth=superficial` to avoid charges on null results.

operations.name: lookup_phone
operations.description: Cost: 3 credits / successful request. No credits are charged when no social media profiles are found. Find social media profiles from a contact phone number.

operations.name: get_job
operations.description: Cost: 2 credits / successful request. Get structured data of a Job Profile.

operations.name: search_jobs
operations.description: Cost: 2 credits / successful request. List jobs posted by a company.

operations.name: get_job_count
operations.description: Cost: 2 credits / successful request. Count the number of jobs posted by a company.

operations.name: search_companies
operations.description: Cost: 3 credits / Company URL. Search for companies that meet a set of criteria within our exhaustive dataset of company profiles.

operations.name: search_people
operations.description: Cost: 3 credits / Profile URL. Search for people who meet a set of criteria within our exhaustive dataset of people profiles.

operations.name: get_credit_balance
